backend/cryptoHolding.mo: Defines the CryptoHolding type with fields for id, symbol, amount, amount invested in GBP, and current value in GBP.
backend/livePortfolioSnapshot.mo: Defines the LivePortfolioSnapshot type with a timestamp and total portfolio value in GBP.
backend/main.mo: Main actor for the backend, managing per-user holdings, staking rewards, portfolio history, live snapshots, and user profiles with authorization checks via AccessControl and MixinAuthorization.
backend/portfolioHistoryRecord.mo: Defines the PortfolioHistoryRecord type capturing a timestamp, total value in GBP, and total amount invested in GBP.
backend/portfolioMetrics.mo: Defines the PortfolioMetrics type with total value, gain/loss, and percentage change fields in GBP.
backend/stakingReward.mo: Defines the StakingReward type with id, symbol, amount, and reward date fields.
backend/timeRange.mo: Defines the TimeRange variant type with options for hourly live, day, week, month, six months, year, and all time.
backend/userProfile.mo: Defines the UserProfile type containing a single name text field.
feature_evidence.json: A feature evidence report JSON file with an empty features array.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON file containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose of each component, hook, and page.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors, borders, charts, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite app, mounting the React root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up QueryClient, ThemeProvider, and BackgroundColorProvider, then conditionally renders LoginPrompt, ProfileSetupModal, or Dashboard based on authentication and profile state.
frontend/src/components/AddHoldingDialog: Dialog for adding a new crypto holding with symbol autocomplete, token amount, and GBP investment inputs, using live CoinGecko prices to calculate current value.
frontend/src/components/AddStakingReward: Dialog form for recording a new staking reward with symbol, amount, and date fields, converting the date to nanoseconds before submitting.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundColorP: A row of circular color swatch buttons with tooltips that allow the user to select a background color from predefined options via BackgroundColorContext.
frontend/src/components/EditHoldingDialo: A dialog component for editing an existing crypto holding, allowing users to update the symbol, token amount, and GBP investment amount, with live price fetching to recalculate current value.
frontend/src/components/EditStakingRewar: A dialog component for editing an existing staking reward entry, with fields for symbol, amount, and reward date, converting the date to nanoseconds before submitting the update.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A simple footer component displaying a copyright notice and a link to caffeine.ai with an animated heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: A sticky header component providing app branding, Internet Identity login/logout, theme toggling, background color picking, and a welcome message for authenticated users.
A tabbed manager component that displays crypto holdings and staking rewards, fetches live GBP prices to compute current values, and supports adding, editing, incrementing, and deleting holdings.
frontend/src/components/IncrementHolding: A dialog component for adding additional tokens and investment amount to an existing crypto holding, merging the new values with the existing holding data on submit.
frontend/src/components/IndividualCrypto: A modal component that displays detailed performance metrics for a single cryptocurrency, including total holdings, staking rewards, gain/loss, and a 30-day interpolated line chart.
frontend/src/components/LoginPrompt.tsx: A landing/login page component that prompts unauthenticated users to sign in via Internet Identity, displaying a hero section and three feature cards highlighting live prices, security, and analytics.
frontend/src/components/PerformanceHisto: A line chart component that fetches and displays historical portfolio value vs. invested amount over selectable time ranges (1D to ALL) using real backend data.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioChart.t: A simple line chart component that renders an interpolated portfolio value curve between the invested amount and current value over a selected time range, with no real historical data.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioComposi: A donut pie chart component that aggregates holdings and staking rewards by symbol and visualizes their GBP value distribution across the portfolio.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioOvervie: The main portfolio dashboard component that calculates live portfolio totals using real-time prices, renders summary stats, time-range selectors, multiple sub-charts, and per-asset cards with a drill-down modal.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioPerform: Renders an area chart showing portfolio value vs. invested amount over a selected time range using simulated smoothstep-interpolated data points. Supports multiple time ranges and formats values in GBP.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioValueHi: Displays a real line chart of historical portfolio GBP value fetched from the backend, with a time range selector (1D to ALL) and loading/empty states.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal card form that prompts new users to enter their name and creates their profile via the `useSaveCallerUserProfile` mutation.
frontend/src/components/StakingRewardsMa: Manages staking rewards with a table listing rewards sorted by date, showing live GBP values, and supporting add, edit, and delete operations via dialogs.
frontend/src/contexts/BackgroundColorCon: Provides a React context for selecting and applying a background color theme from a predefined set of color options across the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCryptoPrices.ts: Fetches live GBP prices and 24h change data for given crypto symbols from the CoinGecko API, mapping symbols to CoinGecko IDs, with 30-second refresh intervals.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines TanStack Query hooks for all backend actor interactions including CRUD operations for user profiles, crypto holdings, staking rewards, and portfolio history.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet using Tailwind CSS that defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light/dark themes with cyan-blue accents, plus custom animations like fadeInGlow and pulseGlow.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page that fetches holdings and staking rewards, shows skeleton loaders while loading, then renders PortfolioOverview and HoldingsManager components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with OKLCH color tokens, custom border radii, box shadows, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata file tracking the current state of a Crypto Portfolio Tracker, with one pending feature request to restore lost canister state by seeding hardcoded demo data after a Version 47 deployment data loss.
